messages.author: 8c45483022d450d5
messages.subject: Space within items in legend?
parts:
Hi

I am using a horizontal legend, whihc looks hoewver very "stressed" with
few spaces between each items... How can one change this, adding extra
space? A workaround would be to add white space in legend labels, but
not very elegant... any hint?

Thanks!

library(ggplot2)
data(diamonds)
dsmall <- diamonds[sample(nrow(diamonds), 100), ]

qplot(carat, data = diamonds, geom = "histogram", fill =
color)+opts(legend.position="top",legend.direction="horizontal")
